flipped.verdict: REJECT (step 2: the operator signature does not verify)

does_not_prove: that the operator kept no copy of the deleted data: no cryptography can prove that (overview L-2; spec §11.3)
that the user personally authorised the deletion: the application backend holds the account key and decides who may delete (overview L-27; spec §3.3)
that the deletion leaf itself was appended, that a group's certificates chain, and that the log is consistent: the auditor checks these with log access (spec §11.3)
